content:
alexandra: FYI CI perf gate tripped on my PR (13489) — microbench `kv_fold_latency` shows +11-12% vs main, and kernel selector picked fallback kernels more often.
ci-bot: perf-check: FAILED for bench/kv_fold_latency. baseline=0.0232s new=0.0259s (+11.6%). full diff: https://ci.internal/bench/diff/13489
maria: can you repro locally on the bench harness? any flamegraphs or perf records?
alexandra: repro steps I used: `./ci/bench --bench kv_fold --seed 42 --runs 500` on a stable A40 image. attaching short log excerpt:
```
KV fold: avg=0.0259 p99=0.0473 kv_hits=0.872
kernel_path: fallback-quant -> 58% (was 12% on main)
```
devin: can you share the bisect range? I vaguely remember a kernel-affinity tweak merged recently.
alexandra: starting bisect now. range is origin/main..pr/13489. first suspect commit: 13460a7 "kernel: soft-affinity for quantized kernels" — stepping through.
benchy: I ran a quick harness on staging A40 too: KV hit rate dipped ~3% and 99th jumped ~15ms. looks correlated with kernel fallback frequency.
jamie: uploaded a lightweight perf trace to the traces bucket: s3://redwood-traces/trace-4600123456/ — flamegraph shows extra time in `select_kernel_for_sequence` and `attempt_quant_path`.

sample stack top (trimmed):
```
select_kernel_for_sequence()
  -> evaluate_affinity()
  -> score_quant_path()
  -> cuda_interop_fallback()
```

maria: if bisect lands on 13460a7 we should consider reverting or hotfixing the selector weights. rollback would be fastest for rollout-blocker.
devin: alternatively I can try a config patch to bias short-seq workloads back to the old kernel. tiny change in `runtime/kernel_selector.cpp` weights:
```
- affinity.short_seq = 0.6;
+ affinity.short_seq = 0.3;
```
That might reduce fallback churn while we investigate.
alexandra: I'll open a quick follow-up PR with the config patch and queue CI, less risky than full revert.
ci-bot: build queued: redwood/13489-config-patch · job/7682. Benchmarks scheduled.
benchy: one more data point: commit 13395 modified KV eviction timing (`kv/evict_timer`), could be interacting by increasing cold misses for short traces — might be a two-commit interaction. recommend adding 13395 to the bisect matrix.
maria: good catch. Devin can you run a two-dimensional bisect (13460 vs 13395) or pairwise runs? benchy can run the harness across both combos.
devin: will do pairwise runs this afternoon. assigning myself. benchy, can you reserve staging A40 for ~2h?
benchy: reserving now. will run the matrix and post summarized diffs in this thread.
alexandra: thanks — holding rollout until CI gates green. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: perf run results will post back here when complete.
